name: king_cobra_reared_gape
description: King cobra (Ophiophagus hannah): heavy olive #6b7a3a body, darker olive back #4f5a2a, thin pale cream chevron bands #e8e0a8 pointing toward the head and fading toward it, pale yellow throat #e8d890, large smooth head shields, small dark eye under a heavy brow, NARROW hood (barely wider than the neck; never the wide Naja disc). Same pose and geometry as king_cobra_reared; only the mouth changes: open about 35 degrees, pale pink-grey lining #c8a0a0, two small fangs at the front, no drool. Anchor bottom-centre; bbox x -328..+188, y -607..0.
